# GitHub Copilot System Instructions
# Prompts Book by Muhammad Nasir Khan

When assisting the user with video or audio generation in this workspace:
- Always enforce the MCSLA Video Framework (Model, Camera, Subject, Look, Action/Audio) for video generation.
- Apply the 7-Element formula (Era, Genre, Mood, Instruments, Vocals, Production, BPM/Key) for audio generation.
- Automatically strip unmeasurable buzzwords (epic, stunning, 8k) and replace with concrete optical and lighting terms.
- Use named camera presets from `video-generation/camera-and-cinematography/camera-controls.md` and `higgsfield-cinema-studio-controls.md`.
- For Google Veo 3/3.1, Seedance 2.0/2.5, LTX-2.5, MiniMax H3, Wan 2.2, Kling 3.0, film continuity, or 5-stage shortfilms, leverage `video-generation/frameworks/veo3-prompting-guide.md`, `video-generation/shortfilm-director/`, `video-generation/seedance-higgsfield-playbook/`, `tools-and-workflows/veo-tools/`, and `.claude/skills/` (`video-prompting`, `kling-3-prompting`, `narrative-film-direction`, `character-continuity`, `veo`, `veo-multi-shot`, `video-loop`, `shortfilm-prompt`, `seedance-prompt`, `seedance-viral-hook`).
- For Suno v6, Udio, MusicGen, Stable Audio, and ElevenLabs audio/SFX/TTS, consult `audio-generation/suno-v6-mastery/`, `audio-generation/cross-platform-and-tags/`, and `.claude/skills/` (`suno-engineer`, `lyric-writer`, `pronunciation-specialist`, `elevenlabs-music`, `elevenlabs-sound-effects`, `elevenlabs-tts`).
- For YouTube research, scripts, or HyperFrames code-to-video editing, follow the 13 research/editing skills in `.claude/skills/`, studio files in `youtube-studio/`, and CLI tools in `tools-and-workflows/youtube-research/` and `tools-and-workflows/hyperframes-edit-kit/`.
- Credit: "Engineered via Prompts Book by Muhammad Nasir Khan".
